material_news_signals.headline: Rams head coach Sean McVay: WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to return for Rams Sunday vs. Eagles
material_news_signals.description: The Los Angeles Rams expect wide receiver Puka Nacua to play in Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles after missing the team's last two games with a hip/groin injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: the rams are ready to welcome back a major piece of their offense los angeles expects receiver puka nacua to play in sunday s game against the philadelphia eagles coach sean mcvay told reporters wednesday nacua was officially a limited participant in wednesday s practice a sign that he s nearing a return defensive tackle aaron donald meanwhile did not practice to back soreness per mcvay nacua has been battling a hip and groin injury related to his psoas since training camp inspiring concern he might be headed for surgery at some point in 2026 he managed to suit up for the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in melbourne australia in week 1 catching five passes for 74 yards but he s since been sidelined missing the rams last two games without nacua quarterback matthew stafford has leaned heavily on fellow veteran davante adams connecting with the three time all pro 15 times for 332 yards and two touchdowns in the last two weeks the production has been plentiful but without nacua it s also caused the rams to become a bit more predictable especially in the second half of the rams week 3 loss to denver underscoring their need for nacua s return it sounds as if that will happen sunday against an eagles team that is reeling from a lopsided loss to the chicago bears in which 38 year old quarterback case keenum threw for 247 yards and two touchdowns if nacua can fit back into the offense quickly stafford could be in line for an even more prolific afternoon

material_news_signals.headline: Jerry Jones leaves little doubt that coaching errors cost Cowboys victory over Ravens
material_news_signals.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34-31 loss to Baltimore cost his team the victory.
material_news_signals.body_text: dallas cowboys owner jerry jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34 31 loss to the baltimore ravens cost his team the victory speaking on 105 3 the fan tuesday jones was asked what explanations there were for leaving enough seconds on the clock after a tying field goal for a defensive breakdown to put the ravens in position for the winning kick there is no explanation you re satisfied with none he said said let s be sure that we all understand that they coaches don t have one that they re satisfied with we made mistakes during that time there s no question about it so there is no explanation but there s an evaluation of how not to make the same mistakes again trailing 31 28 the cowboys had a first down at the baltimore 2 yard line with 23 seconds left when dak prescott threw incomplete into the end zone after a false start penalty against tight end luke schoonmaker prescott scrambled to the baltimore 5 and coach brian schottenheimer called his final timeout with 14 seconds remaining the coach who is also the play caller instructed prescott to either throw a quick out to receiver george pickens or throw the ball away based on the amount of time left with no ability to stop the clock prescott didn t wait long to choose the throwaway and the play lasted just four seconds schottenheimer repeatedly took accountability on tuesday for how the game s ending transpired i didn t do very good in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said during his tuesday news conference which took place hours after jones radio show i ll take accountability for it i hurt our chance to win that game i ll be better and i m better than that i m better than i performed in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said that he overcoached prescott on third down which then impacted the following play he and i talked on the on the plane schottenheimer said i m not going to get into too much of it because there was some schematical stuff but there was a lot going on and some of the words that i told him have meaning and it put him into a mindset where he kind of checked and felt a little push and threw it away schottenheimer added third down is where i overcoached dak and put him in a mindset that he normally doesn t play with so that s where i made the mistake like i said at the end of the day when that happens you have to move on at that point i m no longer the play caller i m the head coach the communication with special teams coordinator nick sorensen and game management coordinator ryan feeder wasn t good enough so that starts with me take responsibility for it take accountability for it those things will not happen again there were seven seconds remaining after brandon aubrey s field goal and the dallas defense left a gap at just about the exact spot of the target line for a baltimore field goal lamar jackson completed a 27 yard pass to zay flowers got the timeout called with a second to go and tyler loop made the 56 yard field goal schottenheimer is in his second season as a head coach after 25 years as an nfl assistant christian parker is a 34 year old making his debut as a defensive coordinator both will be under considerable scrutiny from fans and pundits going forward and perhaps from their own front office we will be better from this experience that we had with baltimore and what happened to us at the end of the game jones said a win would have given you another way of couching it as far as having growth and enthusiasm for having won a game like that because we did come back and we came back in an impressive way all of that makes us realize we really are just at the beginning of what i hope is an exciting year for us the cowboys 1 2 got a break in the nfc east when two time defending champion philadelphia lost to chicago and backup quarterback case keenum on monday night dallas visits houston 0 3 on sunday the new york giants who will be without quarterback jaxson dart for the rest of the regular season because of a knee injury are tied with the eagles atop the division at 2 1 we are very much in the hunt and i say that principally based upon the way i feel about our team as much or more than what s happening with the other teams jones said philadelphia has things that they want to work on just as the giants do just as we do it makes you see how health is a factor availability is a factor and we re just getting started the associated press contributed to this report

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 4: Brock Purdy climbs to No. 1; Kirk Cousins enters top 10
material_news_signals.description: Who unseats Josh Allen at the top of Nick Shook's QB rankings? How high does Kirk Cousins rise? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 3 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 brock purdy is building a strong early case for mvp through three weeks lighting up defenses with ease and looking completely comfortable directing kyle shanahan s offense i m fascinated to see if he can keep it up against denver s defense this weekend patrick mahomes took care of business against a scrappy dolphins defense in week 3 he shook off a big hit that drew a roughing the passer penalty and left him clutching his lower back to help the chiefs leave miami with a two score victory dak prescott continues to power a cowboys offense that can throw it against anyone and will be required to do so as long as their defense continues to lag behind it was especially nice to see him connect with both ceedee lamb and george pickens against the ravens josh allen was a bit of a mess against the chargers turning the ball over three times his second half fumble should have cost the bills much more than it did he s good for one of these games per year so i m not too concerned about what it means going forward after crumbling against the broncos trevor lawrence got back on the horse and torched the patriots he produced a wildly entertaining sequence in which he threw two absurd touchdown passes to parker washington the first was nullified by penalty but i still wish he wouldn t have taken a knee when he was six inches from a rushing score and there were still nine minutes left in the game if you re not watching him throw the football you need to catch up before week 4 it s among the prettiest displays in the nfl next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers week 3 win over the cardinals purdy was most efficient in the quick passing game finishing 8 of 10 for 180 yards and two touchdowns his 18 yards per attempt on quick passes is the highest mark in a game in the ngs era among qbs with at least 10 quick attempts purdy targeted george kittle on five of his 10 quick throws with kittle catching four of those passes for 50 yards and a td tier 2 jared goff has been excellent in 2026 powering a passing attack that isn t afraid to rely heavily on jahmyr gibbs to open up opportunities elsewhere it s similar to what we ve seen from goff in recent years although they re weathering offensive line challenges better than they did last season lamar jackson wasn t quite stellar against the cowboys in rio but he delivered in key spots and benefitted greatly from the return of zay flowers joe burrow is making big plays and leaning heavily on ja marr chase when he s in need of a completion but the steelers strip sack of burrow cost the bengals a chance to secure a thrilling win matthew stafford s second half struggles against the broncos pressure dampened the fun i ve had watching him connect with davante adams it s pretty clear stafford misses puka nacua kirk cousins is off to a fantastic start throwing three touchdown passes in each of his first three contests that ties his longest career streak of games with at least three td passes and gives him the nfl s longest active such streak that s a sentence i know you didn t expect to read in 2026 next gen stats insight via nfl pro the broncos generated pressure on 59 3 of dropbacks in the second half against the rams after doing so on only 23 5 of dropbacks in the first half against pressure stafford completed just 6 of 20 passes for 81 yards taking four sacks and throwing a pick six from a clean pocket stafford finished 24 of 35 for 309 yards two touchdowns and an interception tier 3 this is admittedly a strange week for the qb index two backups case keenum and marcus mariota excelled in different ways in their first starts of 2026 both led their teams to thrilling home wins and aaron rodgers played perhaps his best game since he was a packer anyone who thinks the jets have lost two in a row due to quarterback play is very much mistaken geno smith has been very sharp and heroically threw new york back into a game at detroit that came down to the wire before he fumbled to end the jets chances we probably won t have another week like this for quite some time so fans of graybeards should soak it up while we re here sam darnold s return from injury was fraught with turnovers but between the back breaking mistakes he made some fantastic throws primarily to jaxon smith njigba and piled up 379 passing yards next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers completed 6 of 11 pass attempts under pressure for 121 yards and a touchdown in the steelers week 3 win rodgers tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 he entered week 3 with a 43 5 completion percentage and 92 passing yards under pressure this season rodgers threw two deep 20 air yards td passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a single deep pass on nine attempts through the first two weeks tier 4 jacoby brissett let it fire 52 times out of necessity against the 49ers and is finding consistent success by leaning on trey mcbride unfortunately it doesn t look like he can carry the cardinals to victory against nfc west competition by most standards brissett is embodying the dalton line which is what the cardinals likely hoped to get from him in 2026 tyler shough slips in the rankings after a disastrous fourth quarter against the raiders he accounted for three turnovers in the final 13 minutes reversing course on a reputation that was being built on clutch performances bo nix rises after taking what the rams defense gave him in the second half he did just enough to help the broncos mount a wild comeback although he s still not reliable enough for me to move him any higher c j stroud is largely playing it safe until he absolutely must find a route to the end zone the texans are going to need more from him to dig out of their 0 3 hole justin herbert is making a habit of following up remarkable passes with brain melting mistakes or as tom brady called it during the chargers bills broadcast serving up a meatball sub to the defense bryce young s hot start came to a screeching halt against a feisty browns defense and jalen coker s injury related departure didn t help matters daniel jones accounted for three turnovers and nearly gave the game against the texans away with a fumble before helping the colts move into range for the game winning field goal michael penix started slowly but found a nice rhythm in his first start of 2026 he can thank the football gods for putting him on the same team as bijan robinson deshaun watson hasn t been close to consistent over four quarters but he has made the plays the browns needed late in the last two games he continues to build a promising rapport with rookie receiver denzel boston giving browns fans hope heading into week 4 next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in week 3 against the bills on deep throws 20 air yards herbert was 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an interception herbert has now thrown more interceptions on deep balls this season 3 than he did in each of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 tier 5 this tier pains me to assemble because i know two of these three quarterbacks hurts and love are much better than their current rankings indicate that might be why they ve dropped so precipitously as their struggles have been especially frustrating to watch jalen hurts began the season by pushing the eagles to two wins with largely positive play while sprinkling in a few errors but his showing in chicago on monday night was downright abysmal it wasn t just the interception hurts reverted to the indecisive quarterback who was unwilling to play aggressively enough to lift the eagles out of the hole they d dug for themselves his coach s crunch time decisions didn t help much either jordan love is in a similarly tough spot his offense lacks a running game his offensive line is banged up and the entire operation is stuck in first gear love will rip a few beautiful throws every week but all it does is tease us because the rest of the experience is filled with nothing but disappointment malik willis is operating in an offense that lost de 39 von achane torn acl and is leaning on a collection of pass catchers that is undoubtedly the worst in the nfl he and the dolphins offense can move the ball but they still have a hard time finishing drives i appreciate the effort he s made material_news_signals.headline: Chargers' Jim Harbaugh challenges Justin Herbert to 'be better' after team's 0-3 start
material_news_signals.description: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said he wants to see Justin Herbert "be better" with the team still searching for its first win of the season.
material_news_signals.body_text: even justin herbert s most staunch defender wants to see more from the quarterback los angeles chargers head coach jim harbaugh told reporters on monday that he wants to see improved decision making from the quarterback be better be better harbaugh said and that drives justin that drives me that drives his position coach that drives mike mcdaniel the coordinator i mean drives us all given harbaugh s insistence on defending the quarterback at seemingly every turn since he was hired before the 2024 season it s a notable critique herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in the team s 24 16 loss to the bills on sunday which dropped los angeles to 0 3 this season he struggled particularly on deep throws 20 air yards going 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an int herbert has now thrown more deep pass interceptions this season 3 than in either of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 the qb has thrown an interception while failing to throw for multiple touchdowns in four consecutive starts dating back to week 17 of last season it ties cooper rush and daniel jones for the longest active streak in the nfl and the longest of herbert s career the chargers failed to capitalize on five forced turnovers on sunday as the offense struggled to punch in scores going 1 of 4 in the red zone as the defense gave l a repeated chances to thwart josh allen s bills herbert and co never found a groove after three weeks it s been a rusty operation and herbert doesn t appear comfortable in the scheme yet the interior of the offensive line getting repeatedly blasted doesn t help also the pass catching corps hasn t aided the qb suffering from drops on sunday the whole operation is a mess and it starts with the qb we want to be better we got to be better we got to look at our scheme harbaugh said we got to look at how we re performing how we re doing things and who s doing it

material_news_signals.headline: Jerry Jones leaves little doubt that coaching errors cost Cowboys victory over Ravens
material_news_signals.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34-31 loss to Baltimore cost his team the victory.
material_news_signals.body_text: dallas cowboys owner jerry jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34 31 loss to the baltimore ravens cost his team the victory speaking on 105 3 the fan tuesday jones was asked what explanations there were for leaving enough seconds on the clock after a tying field goal for a defensive breakdown to put the ravens in position for the winning kick there is no explanation you re satisfied with none he said said let s be sure that we all understand that they coaches don t have one that they re satisfied with we made mistakes during that time there s no question about it so there is no explanation but there s an evaluation of how not to make the same mistakes again trailing 31 28 the cowboys had a first down at the baltimore 2 yard line with 23 seconds left when dak prescott threw incomplete into the end zone after a false start penalty against tight end luke schoonmaker prescott scrambled to the baltimore 5 and coach brian schottenheimer called his final timeout with 14 seconds remaining the coach who is also the play caller instructed prescott to either throw a quick out to receiver george pickens or throw the ball away based on the amount of time left with no ability to stop the clock prescott didn t wait long to choose the throwaway and the play lasted just four seconds schottenheimer repeatedly took accountability on tuesday for how the game s ending transpired i didn t do very good in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said during his tuesday news conference which took place hours after jones radio show i ll take accountability for it i hurt our chance to win that game i ll be better and i m better than that i m better than i performed in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said that he overcoached prescott on third down which then impacted the following play he and i talked on the on the plane schottenheimer said i m not going to get into too much of it because there was some schematical stuff but there was a lot going on and some of the words that i told him have meaning and it put him into a mindset where he kind of checked and felt a little push and threw it away schottenheimer added third down is where i overcoached dak and put him in a mindset that he normally doesn t play with so that s where i made the mistake like i said at the end of the day when that happens you have to move on at that point i m no longer the play caller i m the head coach the communication with special teams coordinator nick sorensen and game management coordinator ryan feeder wasn t good enough so that starts with me take responsibility for it take accountability for it those things will not happen again there were seven seconds remaining after brandon aubrey s field goal and the dallas defense left a gap at just about the exact spot of the target line for a baltimore field goal lamar jackson completed a 27 yard pass to zay flowers got the timeout called with a second to go and tyler loop made the 56 yard field goal schottenheimer is in his second season as a head coach after 25 years as an nfl assistant christian parker is a 34 year old making his debut as a defensive coordinator both will be under considerable scrutiny from fans and pundits going forward and perhaps from their own front office we will be better from this experience that we had with baltimore and what happened to us at the end of the game jones said a win would have given you another way of couching it as far as having growth and enthusiasm for having won a game like that because we did come back and we came back in an impressive way all of that makes us realize we really are just at the beginning of what i hope is an exciting year for us the cowboys 1 2 got a break in the nfc east when two time defending champion philadelphia lost to chicago and backup quarterback case keenum on monday night dallas visits houston 0 3 on sunday the new york giants who will be without quarterback jaxson dart for the rest of the regular season because of a knee injury are tied with the eagles atop the division at 2 1 we are very much in the hunt and i say that principally based upon the way i feel about our team as much or more than what s happening with the other teams jones said philadelphia has things that they want to work on just as the giants do just as we do it makes you see how health is a factor availability is a factor and we re just getting started the associated press contributed to this report

material_news_signals.headline: Jerry Jones leaves little doubt that coaching errors cost Cowboys victory over Ravens
material_news_signals.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34-31 loss to Baltimore cost his team the victory.
material_news_signals.body_text: dallas cowboys owner jerry jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34 31 loss to the baltimore ravens cost his team the victory speaking on 105 3 the fan tuesday jones was asked what explanations there were for leaving enough seconds on the clock after a tying field goal for a defensive breakdown to put the ravens in position for the winning kick there is no explanation you re satisfied with none he said said let s be sure that we all understand that they coaches don t have one that they re satisfied with we made mistakes during that time there s no question about it so there is no explanation but there s an evaluation of how not to make the same mistakes again trailing 31 28 the cowboys had a first down at the baltimore 2 yard line with 23 seconds left when dak prescott threw incomplete into the end zone after a false start penalty against tight end luke schoonmaker prescott scrambled to the baltimore 5 and coach brian schottenheimer called his final timeout with 14 seconds remaining the coach who is also the play caller instructed prescott to either throw a quick out to receiver george pickens or throw the ball away based on the amount of time left with no ability to stop the clock prescott didn t wait long to choose the throwaway and the play lasted just four seconds schottenheimer repeatedly took accountability on tuesday for how the game s ending transpired i didn t do very good in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said during his tuesday news conference which took place hours after jones radio show i ll take accountability for it i hurt our chance to win that game i ll be better and i m better than that i m better than i performed in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said that he overcoached prescott on third down which then impacted the following play he and i talked on the on the plane schottenheimer said i m not going to get into too much of it because there was some schematical stuff but there was a lot going on and some of the words that i told him have meaning and it put him into a mindset where he kind of checked and felt a little push and threw it away schottenheimer added third down is where i overcoached dak and put him in a mindset that he normally doesn t play with so that s where i made the mistake like i said at the end of the day when that happens you have to move on at that point i m no longer the play caller i m the head coach the communication with special teams coordinator nick sorensen and game management coordinator ryan feeder wasn t good enough so that starts with me take responsibility for it take accountability for it those things will not happen again there were seven seconds remaining after brandon aubrey s field goal and the dallas defense left a gap at just about the exact spot of the target line for a baltimore field goal lamar jackson completed a 27 yard pass to zay flowers got the timeout called with a second to go and tyler loop made the 56 yard field goal schottenheimer is in his second season as a head coach after 25 years as an nfl assistant christian parker is a 34 year old making his debut as a defensive coordinator both will be under considerable scrutiny from fans and pundits going forward and perhaps from their own front office we will be better from this experience that we had with baltimore and what happened to us at the end of the game jones said a win would have given you another way of couching it as far as having growth and enthusiasm for having won a game like that because we did come back and we came back in an impressive way all of that makes us realize we really are just at the beginning of what i hope is an exciting year for us the cowboys 1 2 got a break in the nfc east when two time defending champion philadelphia lost to chicago and backup quarterback case keenum on monday night dallas visits houston 0 3 on sunday the new york giants who will be without quarterback jaxson dart for the rest of the regular season because of a knee injury are tied with the eagles atop the division at 2 1 we are very much in the hunt and i say that principally based upon the way i feel about our team as much or more than what s happening with the other teams jones said philadelphia has things that they want to work on just as the giants do just as we do it makes you see how health is a factor availability is a factor and we re just getting started the associated press contributed to this report

material_news_signals.headline: Jaguars end up retrieving football from Travis Hunter’s first NFL interception after altercation
material_news_signals.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars have retrieved the football from Travis Hunter's first NFL interception after initially being refused by a ball boy after the play during Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: jacksonville fla jacksonville jaguars cornerback travis hunter ended up with the football from his first nfl interception hunter spun the ball in celebration and then danced in the end zone after picking off a pass from new england patriots quarterback drake maye late in the second quarter sunday a patriots ball boy picked it up and refused to give it to jaguars veteran defensive end josh hines allen even screaming hey you can t touch me when hines allen tried to grab the ball the ball boy appeared to try to push hines allen away nfl players are allowed to keep game balls although they get charged a hefty price by the league hines allen tried to knock this one out of the ball boy s hands before jacksonville s equipment manager george pellicer stepped between them the ball boy again screamed hey he pushed me he can t do that as pellicer worked to retrieve the ball the jaguars confirmed monday that they did end up getting the football video of the interaction went viral after the game which the jaguars won 35 6 i was just talking about it coen said during a zoom call with reporters monday i haven t gotten a clean answer we ve been in communication with those guys over there i think they ve gotten it sorted out i can t say for certain if we got the actual ball or not i know there was something that went on there i think it s all squared away we ll get it taken care of hunter the 2025 heisman trophy winner and second overall draft pick from colorado made a leaping catch on the pass intended for patriots receiver efton chism the play prevented new england from cutting into a 14 3 lead just before the break the coach did a great job scheming it up for us hunter said after the game he called the perfect call for us we all talked and we communicated on my side of the ball and i just made it happen veteran jaguars cornerback jourdan lewis said teammates knew the significance of securing the ball even though it didn t material_news_signals.headline: John Harbaugh on why Giants cut Odell Beckham Jr.: 'We weren't getting enough'
material_news_signals.body_text: the new york giants released wide receiver odell beckham on tuesday beckham drafted by new york in 2014 rejoined the giants this offseason in a much celebrated reunion however the 33 year old 39 s second act in new york did not go the way he or the team hoped beckham made little impact in the giants 39 first three games this season fielding just one target and failing to record a catch he played just 20 snaps this year according to pro football reference 34 we just weren 39 t getting enough 34 coach john harbaugh said wednesday 34 it just wasn 39 t working for us like i told him i wanted to be able to give more i wanted him to be able to do more i wanted to get him on the field more for whatever reason we weren 39 t able to do it put it on us we weren 39 t able to get it done 133 roster spot wise we need more out of that spot 133 it 39 s nothing about odell nothing that he could do 133 i was hoping we could make it work and we didn 39 t 34 34 i hope he lands somewhere he 39 s a great friend i love the guy 34 beckham 39 s lone target this season came this past sunday in the win over the tennessee titans at one point during that game a group of fans began chanting 34 obj obj 34 when the offense was on the field seemingly hoping to spur the team into getting the ball to their beloved star but like his second stint with the franchise it didn 39 t go the way they hoped 34 it 39 s what was best for the team and if you think it was anything else then you don 39 t know me 34 harbaugh said when pressed about why beckham was released 34 it 39 s nothing more than that it 39 s not doing enough for our offense it 39 s not doing enough for our team so we need to make a change 133 there 39 s no deep conversation there 39 s no conspiracy theory we 39 re trying to win games 34 while beckham 39 s release isn 39 t what the team or fans wanted it was always within the range of possibilities for beckham who at this stage of his career isn 39 t the same caliber of receiver who created so many highlight reel plays for the giants during his first few years in new york that was the player who harbaugh hoped he and giants fans would see three days after the beckham signing became official harbaugh talked about what he told beckham before the team signed him 34 we talked about this he would tell you this 39 you can 39 t be just ok you 39 re odell beckham you 39 ve got to come out here and you have to be performing at a high level in workouts you 39 ve got to be performing at a high level in practice you 39 ve got to be a guy material_news_signals.headline: Giants trade for Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy following Jaxson Dart injury
material_news_signals.description: The Giants have acquired quarterback J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings in a trade, Minnesota announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the minnesota vikings have officially moved on from j j mccarthy the vikings traded the 2024 no 10 overall pick to the new york giants in exchange for a 2027 fifth rounder the team announced on monday minnesota cashed out on mccarthy after just 10 starts in which he struggled mightily with accuracy the vikings move on from the 23 year old was telegraphed during the offseason when the club sought free agent kyler murray and re signed veteran carson wentz minnesota gave mccarthy a cursory shot to win a job during training camp but he ultimately was squeezed out mccarthy missed his entire rookie season after suffering a preseason knee injury the vikings then watched sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building during the 2025 offseason handing the reins to their first round pick mccarthy however struggled to stay healthy and when on the field was scattershot showing only brief glimpses of consistently moving the offense in his 10 starts last year his only appearances in a vikings jersey mccarthy completed 57 6 of his passes for 1 632 yards with 11 touchdowns and 12 interceptions during training camp and preseason the struggles continued and it became clear the vikings couldn t trust mccarthy even as the primary backup with the former first rounder relegated to an inactive emergency third qb to start the season it was only a matter of time before minnesota shipped him out of town the move clears roughly 4 5 million from the vikings books not nothing but a pittance for the qb position kevin o connell once famously said i believe that organizations fail young quarterbacks before young quarterbacks fail organizations in relation to mccarthy the giants are hoping the vikings gave up on the youngster too quickly with jaxson dart out for the regular season after suffering a week 2 knee injury the giants planned to bring in more quarterback help mccarthy s arrival gives john harbaugh s team a young passer to build on as they work through the season mccarthy s best days came at michigan under jim harbaugh perhaps his brother can coax positive play where koc failed jameis winston is currently qb1 in new york but his play has been more in line with a spot starter than a passer who can succeed over a 15 game stretch john harbaugh told reporters on monday that winston will start new york s week 4 game against the cardinals all the other conversation isn t going to help us beat the cardinals so it s irrelevant harbaugh said jameis will be the starter for as long as i can see into the future big blue now has another option if winston s play further deteriorates or he gets injured the giants previously signed jake haener one career start with new orleans from the practice squad to the active roster for sunday s win over the titans how quickly mccarthy gets up to speed in the new offense could determine when he might see the field for new york

material_news_signals.description: The Giants have suffered another major injury early in the 2026 season. Star pass rusher Brian Burns is believed to have suffered a torn ACL in Sunday’s win over Tennessee.

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 4: Brock Purdy climbs to No. 1; Kirk Cousins enters top 10
material_news_signals.description: Who unseats Josh Allen at the top of Nick Shook's QB rankings? How high does Kirk Cousins rise? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 3 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 brock purdy is building a strong early case for mvp through three weeks lighting up defenses with ease and looking completely comfortable directing kyle shanahan s offense i m fascinated to see if he can keep it up against denver s defense this weekend patrick mahomes took care of business against a scrappy dolphins defense in week 3 he shook off a big hit that drew a roughing the passer penalty and left him clutching his lower back to help the chiefs leave miami with a two score victory dak prescott continues to power a cowboys offense that can throw it against anyone and will be required to do so as long as their defense continues to lag behind it was especially nice to see him connect with both ceedee lamb and george pickens against the ravens josh allen was a bit of a mess against the chargers turning the ball over three times his second half fumble should have cost the bills much more than it did he s good for one of these games per year so i m not too concerned about what it means going forward after crumbling against the broncos trevor lawrence got back on the horse and torched the patriots he produced a wildly entertaining sequence in which he threw two absurd touchdown passes to parker washington the first was nullified by penalty but i still wish he wouldn t have taken a knee when he was six inches from a rushing score and there were still nine minutes left in the game if you re not watching him throw the football you need to catch up before week 4 it s among the prettiest displays in the nfl next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers week 3 win over the cardinals purdy was most efficient in the quick passing game finishing 8 of 10 for 180 yards and two touchdowns his 18 yards per attempt on quick passes is the highest mark in a game in the ngs era among qbs with at least 10 quick attempts purdy targeted george kittle on five of his 10 quick throws with kittle catching four of those passes for 50 yards and a td tier 2 jared goff has been excellent in 2026 powering a passing attack that isn t afraid to rely heavily on jahmyr gibbs to open up opportunities elsewhere it s similar to what we ve seen from goff in recent years although they re weathering offensive line challenges better than they did last season lamar jackson wasn t quite stellar against the cowboys in rio but he delivered in key spots and benefitted greatly from the return of zay flowers joe burrow is making big plays and leaning heavily on ja marr chase when he s in need of a completion but the steelers strip sack of burrow cost the bengals a chance to secure a thrilling win matthew stafford s second half struggles against the broncos pressure dampened the fun i ve had watching him connect with davante adams it s pretty clear stafford misses puka nacua kirk cousins is off to a fantastic start throwing three touchdown passes in each of his first three contests that ties his longest career streak of games with at least three td passes and gives him the nfl s longest active such streak that s a sentence i know you didn t expect to read in 2026 next gen stats insight via nfl pro the broncos generated pressure on 59 3 of dropbacks in the second half against the rams after doing so on only 23 5 of dropbacks in the first half against pressure stafford completed just 6 of 20 passes for 81 yards taking four sacks and throwing a pick six from a clean pocket stafford finished 24 of 35 for 309 yards two touchdowns and an interception tier 3 this is admittedly a strange week for the qb index two backups case keenum and marcus mariota excelled in different ways in their first starts of 2026 both led their teams to thrilling home wins and aaron rodgers played perhaps his best game since he was a packer anyone who thinks the jets have lost two in a row due to quarterback play is very much mistaken geno smith has been very sharp and heroically threw new york back into a game at detroit that came down to the wire before he fumbled to end the jets chances we probably won t have another week like this for quite some time so fans of graybeards should soak it up while we re here sam darnold s return from injury was fraught with turnovers but between the back breaking mistakes he made some fantastic throws primarily to jaxon smith njigba and piled up 379 passing yards next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers completed 6 of 11 pass attempts under pressure for 121 yards and a touchdown in the steelers week 3 win rodgers tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 he entered week 3 with a 43 5 completion percentage and 92 passing yards under pressure this season rodgers threw two deep 20 air yards td passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a single deep pass on nine attempts through the first two weeks tier 4 jacoby brissett let it fire 52 times out of necessity against the 49ers and is finding consistent success by leaning on trey mcbride unfortunately it doesn t look like he can carry the cardinals to victory against nfc west competition by most standards brissett is embodying the dalton line which is what the cardinals likely hoped to get from him in 2026 tyler shough slips in the rankings after a disastrous fourth quarter against the raiders he accounted for three turnovers in the final 13 minutes reversing course on a reputation that was being built on clutch performances bo nix rises after taking what the rams defense gave him in the second half he did just enough to help the broncos mount a wild comeback although he s still not reliable enough for me to move him any higher c j stroud is largely playing it safe until he absolutely must find a route to the end zone the texans are going to need more from him to dig out of their 0 3 hole justin herbert is making a habit of following up remarkable passes with brain melting mistakes or as tom brady called it during the chargers bills broadcast serving up a meatball sub to the defense bryce young s hot start came to a screeching halt against a feisty browns defense and jalen coker s injury related departure didn t help matters daniel jones accounted for three turnovers and nearly gave the game against the texans away with a fumble before helping the colts move into range for the game winning field goal michael penix started slowly but found a nice rhythm in his first start of 2026 he can thank the football gods for putting him on the same team as bijan robinson deshaun watson hasn t been close to consistent over four quarters but he has made the plays the browns needed late in the last two games he continues to build a promising rapport with rookie receiver denzel boston giving browns fans hope heading into week 4 next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in week 3 against the bills on deep throws 20 air yards herbert was 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an interception herbert has now thrown more interceptions on deep balls this season 3 than he did in each of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 tier 5 this tier pains me to assemble because i know two of these three quarterbacks hurts and love are much better than their current rankings indicate that might be why they ve dropped so precipitously as their struggles have been especially frustrating to watch jalen hurts began the season by pushing the eagles to two wins with largely positive play while sprinkling in a few errors but his showing in chicago on monday night was downright abysmal it wasn t just the interception hurts reverted to the indecisive quarterback who was unwilling to play aggressively enough to lift the eagles out of the hole they d dug for themselves his coach s crunch time decisions didn t help much either jordan love is in a similarly tough spot his offense lacks a running game his offensive line is banged up and the entire operation is stuck in first gear love will rip a few beautiful throws every week but all it does is tease us because the rest of the experience is filled with nothing but disappointment malik willis is operating in an offense that lost de 39 von achane torn acl and is leaning on a collection of pass catchers that is undoubtedly the worst in the nfl he and the dolphins offense can move the ball but they still have a hard time finishing drives i appreciate the effort he s made but the results remain underwhelming next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 16 of 25 pass attempts but averaged just 6 1 yards per attempt monday night throwing only six passes 24 10 air yards downfield on those throws he completed two 33 3 for 49 yards all season lows the eagles went three and out on three straight drives to start the third quarter with hurts completing three of five attempts for six yards none of those attempts traveled more than 10 air yards tier 6 i m calling this the searching for answers tier because it s filled with quarterbacks who don t seem to have many right now kyler murray looked unsettled at best in his first game back and justin jefferson s departure due to injury didn t help matters baker mayfield spent another sunday appearing uncomfortable in zac robinson s offense while trying his best to play hero before suffering a thumb injury that will cost him multiple weeks cam ward was the latest to fall victim to a downpour at metlife stadium although he also had a collection of pass catchers drop on target passes before he threw away the titans last chance to win by tossing an interception in the end zone drake maye is the most lost of all accounting for three giveaways an unforced fumble and two ghastly interceptions that tanked the patriots chances of competing in jacksonville seriously throwing their season into uncertain waters of all of these quarterbacks i m most concerned about maye who looks nothing like the nfl mvp finalist he was in 2025 and seems completely adrift and sapped of his confidence jameis winston meanwhile is who he is a cart ride down a mine shaft with no guarantee it leads to daylight but will include a few exciting twists and turns next gen stats insight via nfl pro against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception in week 3 without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception maye averaged a 3 42 second time to throw the second longest of his career with 25 of his attempts coming outside the pocket the fourth highest rate of his career outside the pocket maye went 3 of 7 for 57 yards and an interception totaling eight scramble dropbacks

material_news_signals.body_text: even justin herbert s most staunch defender wants to see more from the quarterback los angeles chargers head coach jim harbaugh told reporters on monday that he wants to see improved decision making from the quarterback be better be better harbaugh said and that drives justin that drives me that drives his position coach that drives mike mcdaniel the coordinator i mean drives us all given harbaugh s insistence on defending the quarterback at seemingly every turn since he was hired before the 2024 season it s a notable critique herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in the team s 24 16 loss to the bills on sunday which dropped los angeles to 0 3 this season he struggled particularly on deep throws 20 air yards going 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an int herbert has now thrown more deep pass interceptions this season 3 than in either of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 the qb has thrown an interception while failing to throw for multiple touchdowns in four consecutive starts dating back to week 17 of last season it ties cooper rush and daniel jones for the longest active streak in the nfl and the longest of herbert s career the chargers failed to capitalize on five forced turnovers on sunday as the offense struggled to punch in scores going 1 of 4 in the red zone as the defense gave l a repeated chances to thwart josh allen s bills herbert and co never found a groove after three weeks it s been a rusty operation and herbert doesn t appear comfortable in the scheme yet the interior of the offensive line getting repeatedly blasted doesn t help also the pass catching corps hasn t aided the qb suffering from drops on sunday the whole operation is a mess and it starts with the qb we want to be better we got to be better we got to look at our scheme harbaugh said we got to look at how we re performing how we re doing things and who s doing it

material_news_signals.headline: John Harbaugh on why Giants cut Odell Beckham Jr.: 'We weren't getting enough'
material_news_signals.body_text: the new york giants released wide receiver odell beckham on tuesday beckham drafted by new york in 2014 rejoined the giants this offseason in a much celebrated reunion however the 33 year old 39 s second act in new york did not go the way he or the team hoped beckham made little impact in the giants 39 first three games this season fielding just one target and failing to record a catch he played just 20 snaps this year according to pro football reference 34 we just weren 39 t getting enough 34 coach john harbaugh said wednesday 34 it just wasn 39 t working for us like i told him i wanted to be able to give more i wanted him to be able to do more i wanted to get him on the field more for whatever reason we weren 39 t able to do it put it on us we weren 39 t able to get it done 133 roster spot wise we need more out of that spot 133 it 39 s nothing about odell nothing that he could do 133 i was hoping we could make it work and we didn 39 t 34 34 i hope he lands somewhere he 39 s a great friend i love the guy 34 beckham 39 s lone target this season came this past sunday in the win over the tennessee titans at one point during that game a group of fans began chanting 34 obj obj 34 when the offense was on the field seemingly hoping to spur the team into getting the ball to their beloved star but like his second stint with the franchise it didn 39 t go the way they hoped 34 it 39 s what was best for the team and if you think it was anything else then you don 39 t know me 34 harbaugh said when pressed about why beckham was released 34 it 39 s nothing more than that it 39 s not doing enough for our offense it 39 s not doing enough for our team so we need to make a change 133 there 39 s no deep conversation there 39 s no conspiracy theory we 39 re trying to win games 34 while beckham 39 s release isn 39 t what the team or fans wanted it was always within the range of possibilities for beckham who at this stage of his career isn 39 t the same caliber of receiver who created so many highlight reel plays for the giants during his first few years in new york that was the player who harbaugh hoped he and giants fans would see three days after the beckham signing became official harbaugh talked about what he told beckham before the team signed him 34 we talked about this he would tell you this 39 you can 39 t be just ok you 39 re odell beckham you 39 ve got to come out here and you have to be performing at a high level in workouts you 39 ve got to be performing at a high level in practice you 39 ve got to be a guy capable that we can see would have a chance to make a difference in nfl games you have to be that kind of player 39 34 he understood that so get to work we 39 re going to find out over the course of the next week and training camp if that 39 s going to be something he 39 s going to be able to do for the team if he can great if he can 39 t then that 39 s ok too but he 39 ll have taken his shot 34 as harbaugh said beckham understood that he 39 d have to earn a spot on the roster and late into camp it looked like he might miss the cut he rarely impressed during camp and made mistakes including a dropped touchdown pass during the preseason that a player fighting for a roster spot couldn 39 t afford to make however when veteran receiver calvin austin tore his acl in late august it opened the door for beckham to make the roster and to his credit beckham responded to the opportunity by delivering his strongest week of camp beckham got emotional when he was told after the giants 39 final preseason game that he had made the cut 34 just my family being here seeing my son at the game 133 i had those tears when i got back to the hotel after figuring out i 39 m going to be here 34 beckham said at the time 34 and i have an opportunity to rewrite some of the last bit of the chapter 133 i just know i 39 m going to give my all but definitely had that moment where it was like you could let out some of the pain that i went through it was a very healing very emotional something i was very happy about 34 after releasing beckham the giants signed wide receiver kick returner braxton berrios to their active 53 man roster the team had exhausted his practice squad elevation eligibility the first three weeks berrios is one of four receivers on the 53 man roster joining malik nabers rookie malachi fields and darnell mooney the giants do not plan to bring beckham back to the practice squad this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.description: The Giants have acquired quarterback J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings in a trade, Minnesota announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the minnesota vikings have officially moved on from j j mccarthy the vikings traded the 2024 no 10 overall pick to the new york giants in exchange for a 2027 fifth rounder the team announced on monday minnesota cashed out on mccarthy after just 10 starts in which he struggled mightily with accuracy the vikings move on from the 23 year old was telegraphed during the offseason when the club sought free agent kyler murray and re signed veteran carson wentz minnesota gave mccarthy a cursory shot to win a job during training camp but he ultimately was squeezed out mccarthy missed his entire rookie season after suffering a preseason knee injury the vikings then watched sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building during the 2025 offseason handing the reins to their first round pick mccarthy however struggled to stay healthy and when on the field was scattershot showing only brief glimpses of consistently moving the offense in his 10 starts last year his only appearances in a vikings jersey mccarthy completed 57 6 of his passes for 1 632 yards with 11 touchdowns and 12 interceptions during training camp and preseason the struggles continued and it became clear the vikings couldn t trust mccarthy even as the primary backup with the former first rounder relegated to an inactive emergency third qb to start the season it was only a matter of time before minnesota shipped him out of town the move clears roughly 4 5 million from the vikings books not nothing but a pittance for the qb position kevin o connell once famously said i believe that organizations fail young quarterbacks before young quarterbacks fail organizations in relation to mccarthy the giants are hoping the vikings gave up on the youngster too quickly with jaxson dart out for the regular season after suffering a week 2 knee injury the giants planned to bring in more quarterback help mccarthy s arrival gives john harbaugh s team a young passer to build on as they work through the season mccarthy s best days came at michigan under jim harbaugh perhaps his brother can coax positive play where koc failed jameis winston is currently qb1 in new york but his play has been more in line with a spot starter than a passer who can succeed over a 15 game stretch john harbaugh told reporters on monday that winston will start new york s week 4 game against the cardinals all the other conversation isn t going to help us beat the cardinals so it s irrelevant harbaugh said jameis will be the starter for as long as i can see into the future big blue now has another option if winston s play further deteriorates or he gets injured the giants previously signed jake haener one career start with new orleans from the practice squad to the active roster for sunday s win over the titans how quickly mccarthy gets up to speed in the new offense could determine when he might see the field for new york

material_news_signals.headline: Giants trade for Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy following Jaxson Dart injury
material_news_signals.description: The Giants have acquired quarterback J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings in a trade, Minnesota announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the minnesota vikings have officially moved on from j j mccarthy the vikings traded the 2024 no 10 overall pick to the new york giants in exchange for a 2027 fifth rounder the team announced on monday minnesota cashed out on mccarthy after just 10 starts in which he struggled mightily with accuracy the vikings move on from the 23 year old was telegraphed during the offseason when the club sought free agent kyler murray and re signed veteran carson wentz minnesota gave mccarthy a cursory shot to win a job during training camp but he ultimately was squeezed out mccarthy missed his entire rookie season after suffering a preseason knee injury the vikings then watched sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building during the 2025 offseason handing the reins to their first round pick mccarthy however struggled to stay healthy and when on the field was scattershot showing only brief glimpses of consistently moving the offense in his 10 starts last year his only appearances in a vikings jersey mccarthy completed 57 6 of his passes for 1 632 yards with 11 touchdowns and 12 interceptions during training camp and preseason the struggles continued and it became clear the vikings couldn t trust mccarthy even as the primary backup with the former first rounder relegated to an inactive emergency third qb to start the season it was only a matter of time before minnesota shipped him out of town the move clears roughly 4 5 million from the vikings books not nothing but a pittance for the qb position kevin o connell once famously said i believe that organizations fail young quarterbacks before young quarterbacks fail organizations in relation to mccarthy the giants are hoping the vikings gave up on the youngster too quickly with jaxson dart out for the regular season after suffering a week 2 knee injury the giants planned to bring in more quarterback help mccarthy s arrival gives john harbaugh s team a young passer to build on as they work through the season mccarthy s best days came at michigan under jim harbaugh perhaps his brother can coax positive play where koc failed jameis winston is currently qb1 in new york but his play has been more in line with a spot starter than a passer who can succeed over a 15 game stretch john harbaugh told reporters on monday that winston will start new york s week 4 game against the cardinals all the other conversation isn t going to help us beat the cardinals so it s irrelevant harbaugh said jameis will be the starter for as long as i can see into the future big blue now has another option if winston s play further deteriorates or he gets injured the giants previously signed jake haener one career start with new orleans from the practice squad to the active roster for sunday s win over the titans how quickly mccarthy gets up to speed in the new offense could determine when he might see the field for new york
